title: Smoky Turkish Wraps
description: A flavorful and aromatic wrap filled with smoky spices, topped with a fresh tomato salsa.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together smoked paprika, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Rub the spice mixture evenly over the lamb shoulder.
Place the lamb on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until browned and cooked through.
While the lamb is cooking, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add diced tomato and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Chop fresh parsley and stir in.
Once the lamb is done, let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing into thin strips.
Warm the pita wraps by wrapping them in foil and heating them in the oven for 2-3 minutes.
Assemble the wraps by placing sliced lamb, tomato salsa, and crumbled feta cheese (if using) on each wrap.
Brush the tops of the wraps with olive oil and serve immediately.
